summary: CAPTURED 2026-08-27 from branch fix/salvage-snapshot-base-guard before deleting it — the branch was 74 commits behind main and conflicted, so it could not be merged, and this intent existed NOWHERE else (no inbox item, no commit in main). consumed_by: inbox review 2026-09-27: FIXED.
